title: Leaders In This Phase And Their Role
definition: The Third Phase of the Indian National Movement (1919-1947), often termed the 'Gandhian Era', represents the transition from elite-led constitutional agitation to mass-based, non-violent, and revolutionary resistance against British colonial rule.
importanceInUpsc: This phase is the highest-weightage area in Modern History. UPSC frequently tests the ideological nuances, inter-leader dynamics, and the evolution of strategies (Satyagraha, Non-Cooperation, Civil Disobedience, Quit India).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Leaders In This Phase And Their Role.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
